description: Update a Pipedrive deal. To move it to a different pipeline stage, pass fields:{stage_id:...} — there is no separate "move stage" tool. A move BACKWARDS within the pipeline (earlier stage) is refused unless allow_backward=true — set that only when a human explicitly asked for it. Pass any additional Pipedrive field in `fields`, keyed by its field key/name (call the matching list_pipedrive_*_fields tool first to discover custom field keys and, for enum/set fields, their option ids).

allow_backward.description: Only when a human explicitly asked to move the deal back to an earlier stage.

auf_anweisung.description: Nur fuer Agenten an einem abgeschlossenen Deal (eine der Abschluss-Stages der Pipeline, z. B. Rechnung oder Versand): wer es ausdruecklich verlangt hat, mit Kanal und Zeit, z. B. "Max Mustermann per WhatsApp 20.10. 08:00". Ohne diese Angabe wird ein Agent an einem abgeschlossenen Deal abgewiesen. Nie selbst erfinden.

deal_id.description: ID of the deal to change

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

name: update_pipedrive_deal
